script_text: Stop, Taurus — Venus is about to force a confrontation you've been avoiding all week. Your ruling planet Venus is forming a precise square to the Sun in Virgo, powerfully activating your 6th House of Work and Health, while Mercury races through that same sector, creating friction between your responsibilities and your need for harmony. As an Earth sign that thrives on stability, this transit is shaking your comfort zone in ways you can't ignore. In love, someone close to you is about to reveal a deep truth that changes the entire dynamic — stay composed and truly listen. Career-wise, your 10th House of Public Reputation lights up as Jupiter's trine from your 4th House opens a home-connected opportunity. Avoid any impulsive financial decisions before noon — your 2nd House resources need serious protection. Subscribe so you don't miss what's coming this week.
